arxiv-1705-03968.title: Fluctuation-dissipation theorem for non-equilibrium quantum systems
arxiv-1705-03968.creator: Mohammad Mehboudi, Anna Sanpera, Juan M.R. Parrondo
arxiv-1705-03968.description: Abstract The fluctuation-dissipation theorem (FDT) is a central result in statistical physics, both for classical and quantum systems. It establishes a relationship between the linear response of a system under a time-dependent perturbation and time correlations of certain observables in equilibrium.

arxiv-2103-03965.title: The Intersection of Algorithmically Random Closed Sets and Effective Dimension
arxiv-2103-03965.creator: Adam Case and Christopher P. Porter
arxiv-2103-03965.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Adam Case and Christopher P. Porter. In this article, we study several aspects of the intersections of algorithmically random closed sets. First, we answer a question of Cenzer and Weber, showing that the operation of intersecting relatively random closed sets (with respect to certain underlying measures induced by Bernoulli measures on the space of codes of closed sets), which preserves randomness, can be inverted: a random closed set of the appropriate type can be obtained as the intersection of two relatively random closed sets.

arxiv-2208-02746.title: Conditional expectation operators on C ⁡ ( X ) C(X)
arxiv-2208-02746.creator: Mohamed Amine BEN AMOR
arxiv-2208-02746.description: Abstract At the COSAEF conference in 2021, several participants asked the question whether a conditional expectation operator in the sense of Kuo, Labaushagne and Watson could be constructed in vector lattices other than ℒ p \mathcal{L}_{p} spaces and in particular in C ⁡ ( X ) C(X) .

arxiv-2208-05152.title: TagRec++: Hierarchical Label Aware Attention Network for Question Categorization
arxiv-2208-05152.creator: Venktesh V, Mukesh Mohania, and Vikram Goyal
arxiv-2208-05152.description: Abstract Online learning systems have multiple data repositories in the form of transcripts, books and questions. To enable ease of access, such systems organize the content according to a well defined taxonomy of hierarchical nature (subject - chapter -topic). The task of categorizing inputs to the hierarchical labels is usually cast as a flat multi-class classification problem.

arxiv-2306-10571.title: Quantum Superposition and Entanglement in Spin-Glass Systems
arxiv-2306-10571.creator: Aslı Tuncer, Serhat C. Kadıoğlu
arxiv-2306-10571.description: Abstract We propose that spin glasses can exist in equally probable superposition states (SSs) comprising potential configurations. Employing the Edward-Anderson (EA) order parameter and magnetization, we establish a classification scheme for these SSs based on their contribution to discerning magnetic order (disorder), such as SG, ferromagnetic (FM), and paramagnetic (PM) phases.

arxiv-2505-16929.title: Neutron Star crust informed by nuclear structure data
arxiv-2505-16929.creator: Pietro Klausner, Marco Antonelli, Francesca Gulminelli
arxiv-2505-16929.description: Abstract We perform a Bayesian analysis of the neutron star (NS) equation of state (EoS) based on a wide set of Skyrme functionals, derived from previous nuclear physics inferences. The novelty of this approach lies in starting from the full multidimensional posterior distribution of nuclear matter parameters, consistent with a comprehensive set of static and dynamic nuclear structure observables.

arxiv-2508-16263.creator: Mocheng Li, Xiao Yan, Baotong Lu, Yue Zhang, James Cheng, Chenhao Ma
arxiv-2508-16263.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mocheng Li, Xiao Yan, Baotong Lu, Yue Zhang, James Cheng, Chenhao Ma. With the growing integration of structured and unstructured data, new methods have emerged for performing similarity searches on vectors while honoring structured attribute constraints, i.e., a process known as Filtering Approximate Nearest Neighbor (Filtering ANN) search.

pmc-10737136.title: WHAT LINKS DIGITAL SKILLS AND LIFE SATISFACTION? ROLES OF DIGITAL BENEFITS AND LIVING ARRANGEMENTS
pmc-10737136.creator: Miseon Kang, Seolah Lee, Jungup Lee, Hyo Jung Lee
pmc-10737136.description: The benefits of equipping enhanced digital skills in late life have been reported on many occasions. Yet, there have been few attempts to understand the association between digital skills and better psychological outcomes for older adults by integrating factors with multiple domains such as social and digital-related factors.

pmc-11647326.title: Transition experiences of UK junior doctors who leave clinical practice to pursue careers in medical education: a qualitative study
pmc-11647326.creator: Olivia Coldicutt, Katherine Owen
pmc-11647326.description: ObjectivesThe increasing complexity and scale of medical education in the UK demands increasing numbers of medical educators. A small proportion of educators are qualified doctors, but did not reach completion of clinical training (CCT) to become consultants or general practitioners before pursuing a career exclusively in education.

pmc-11935599.title: Distinct Phenotypic Groups and Related Clinical Outcomes in Patients With Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
pmc-11935599.creator: Soongu Kwak, Jihoon Kim, Chan‐Soon Park, Hyun‐Jung Lee, Jun‐Bean Park, Seung‐Pyo Lee, Yong‐Jin Kim, Hyung‐Kwan Kim, Sang‐Chol Lee
pmc-11935599.description: BackgroundHypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is a heterogeneous disorder with varying risks of clinical outcomes, including sudden cardiac death (SCD). We aimed to identify distinct phenotypes among patients with HCM in relation to SCD risk factors, interpret their clinical characteristics, and examine their outcomes.Methods and ResultsThis retrospective study analyzed 1231 consecutive patients with HCM from 2 tertiary hospitals.

pmc-12485646.title: Adverse Events Following Short-Course Systemic Corticosteroids Among Children and Adolescents
pmc-12485646.creator: João Pedro Lima, Saifur R. Chowdhury, Wimonchat Tangamornsuksan, Chunjuan Zhai, Xiajing Chu, Jessyca Matos Silva, Humayun Kabir, Mahmudur Rahman Chowdhury, Rachel Couban, Michael Walsh, Bram Rochwerg, Mohamed Eltorki, Gordon H. Guyatt, Derek Chu
pmc-12485646.description: This systematic review and meta-analysis investigates whether short-term use of systemic corticosteroids is associated with adverse events among children and adolescents. Introduction Corticosteroids are immunosuppressant anti-inflammatory drugs that, over the decades, have been widely used to treat a variety of children’s illnesses including asthma, croup, and urticaria.

pmc-12590881.title: Galectin-3 directs mitophagy in response to Parkin-/proteasome-dependent rupture of mitochondrial outer membrane
pmc-12590881.creator: Pei-Han Liu, Yu-Shan Lin, Wei-Hua Chu, Wei-Tse Sun, Po-Yu Huang, Jie-rong Huang, Wei-Chung Chiang
pmc-12590881.description: PINK1/Parkin-dependent mitophagy is an intracellular process that selectively removes damaged, depolarized mitochondria. In this form of mitophagy, the mitochondrial outer membrane (OMM) undergoes focal rupture through a Parkin- and proteasome-dependent mechanism, which consequently results in the exposure of mitochondrial inner membrane (IMM) mitophagy receptors. The OMM rupture marks the damaged mitochondria and ensures their proper disposal.

pmc-12743483.title: Auricular Plaster Therapy for Preoperative Anxiety in Major Surgery: A Prospective Matched-Cohort Study of Total Knee Arthroplasty and Pancreaticoduodenectomy Patients
pmc-12743483.creator: Qindong Mi, Qianqian Shao, Fei Bao, Xiaolong Zhao, Defang Zan, Yuhao Liu, Weibin Wang
pmc-12743483.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the association of auricular plaster therapy (AP) with preoperative anxiety in patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty (TKA) and pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple).MethodsA prospective matched-cohort observational study was conducted at Peking Union Medical College Hospital from March 2024 to May 2025. The primary outcome was Perioperative Anxiety Scale-7 (PAS-7) scores at different preoperative timepoints.

pmc-12810158.title: Evaluation of Occlusal Stains and Surface Roughness of Prefabricated Zirconia Crowns in Pediatric Dentistry: An Observational and In Vitro Study
pmc-12810158.creator: Hammam A Bahammam, Ahmed F Rady
pmc-12810158.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Aims and backgroundThe purpose of this study is to assess the alteration of surface roughness and occlusal stains in zirconia crowns produced for pediatric dental applications.Materials and methodsThis study combined clinical observation and in vitro experimentation. The clinical component involved collecting data from 20 pediatric patients under the age of 6 years who received zirconia crowns in their upper teeth and stainless steel crowns (SSCs) in their lower teeth. A standardized shade guide was used to evaluate staining severity.

pmc-12969306.title: Effect of genotype × environment interactions on starch physicochemical properties in diverse sorghum germplasm
pmc-12969306.creator: Muhammad Khubaib Zahid, Jing Yu, Yaqi Hu, Huabing Lu, Jinsong Bao
pmc-12969306.description: Genotypic diversity and genotype-environment (G × E) interactions affecting starch quality parameters were investigated in 28 sorghum genotypes over two growing seasons. Starch granule diameter ranged from 3.22 to 29.20 μm. Amylose content effectively distinguished waxy genotypes (∼5%) from non-waxy (∼20–33%) genotypes. Starch phosphorous content ranged widely from 109.26 to 618.06 ppm in environment 1 (E1) and 106.94 to 1753.

pmc-13017235.title: Effect of tolvaptan on the prognosis of patients with rapidly progressive autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease: a prospective open-label study
pmc-13017235.creator: Li Zhou, Wenge Li
pmc-13017235.description: IntroductionAlthough tolvaptan is internationally recognized for its therapeutic benefits in autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD) and has been referenced in the 2020 Chinese Clinical Practice Guidelines, it has yet to be approved in China due to limited large-scale local evidence.

pmc-13194790.title: A dynamic policy-aware conditional proxy re-encryption system for fine-grained access control in IoT pub/sub systems
pmc-13194790.creator: Shi Lin, Niu Ke, Hu Jun Ru, Li Cui
pmc-13194790.description: The publish-subscribe paradigm has become the mainstream communication model for large-scale Internet of Things (IoT) systems. However, existing end-to-end encryption solutions based on Conditional Proxy Re-Encryption (CPRE) suffer from limitations in supporting dynamic and fine-grained access control policies. This paper proposes a dynamic policy-aware CPRE system that extends traditional CPRE with multi-dimensional condition support and policy hiding capabilities.

pmc-13371335.title: Traumatic stress and eating-related behaviours after the 6 February 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes: a cross-sectional comparative study
pmc-13371335.creator: Hakan Toğuç, Büşra Hökelek
pmc-13371335.description: ObjectiveLarge earthquakes may be associated with traumatic stress and eating-related outcomes, but evidence from Turkey remains limited. This study examined the associations between direct earthquake exposure, post-earthquake traumatic stress, and eating-related outcomes approximately two years after the 6 February 2023 Kahramanmaraş-centred earthquakes.MethodThis cross-sectional comparative online survey was conducted in Turkey between March and June 2025.

pmc-13495255.title: Hand hygiene knowledge, perception, and self-reported practice among healthcare workers in a tertiary care hospital: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13495255.creator: Anbuselvi Danapalan, Nalini Sirala Jagadeesh, Alexander Arthur Bialasiewicz, Mohammed El Ahmady, Ashokkumar Palanivinayagam
pmc-13495255.description: BackgroundHand hygiene (HH) regimens significantly prevent the spread of healthcare-associated infections and multidrug-resistant organisms. Practising correct HH is crucial in achieving the target of near-zero infections. Globally, HH compliance rates among healthcare workers (HCWs) remain suboptimal. This study aimed to evaluate HCWs’ hand hygiene knowledge, perception and self-reported practice and their correlations in a tertiary care hospital in Qatar.
